Name: Fiber From Grass
Author: Wraithguard85
Description:
This mod was created for a very specific niche but can be easily modified in the content.json.

That said, gathering large quantities of fiber is a little challenging at the start of a game and when you use both Custom Hay to prevent hay gathering from grass cutting and Realistic Hay Production to create hay by drying fiber in bales, it can be a real challenge to reliably feed any animals without buying all of the hay.

It then made sense that if animals were going to eat the grass anyways, we should still be able to get the material needed to make the food. After more than just a little help from the folks on the Stardew Valley Discord, this mod was born.

While this mod doesn't require the aforementioned mods, it does need the Extra Animal Configs.

This is a very simple mod, but without that framework and all the help Selph provided, this would not have been possible in so short a time.
